verdict.rationale: The evidence shows non-interactive execution primitives: `-auto-approve` skips the approval prompt, `-json` emits machine-readable output, and `plan -out` saves a plan to apply later. These are building blocks a user could wire into external CI or schedulers. Nothing documents Terraform's own capability to set up scheduled, triggered or background-running automations; the "Automate Infrastructure" tagline and HCP policy-enforcement runs do not describe autonomous background jobs.
